issues.issue: Was the officer's finding on establishment in Canada reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Officer erred in assessing establishment, ignored Principal Applicant's Canadian job prospects and community impact despite significant evidence.
issues.result_text: Officer reasonably linked establishment to the diplomatic posting and expected relocation; no unreasonableness.

issues.issue: Did the officer apply the wrong legal standard by requiring 'exceptional' establishment?
issues.applicant_position: Requiring exceptional establishment without explaining the term is the wrong legal standard (citing Apura).
issues.result_text: Preponderance of jurisprudence (Huang, Li) rejects the applicants' 'exceptional' standard argument.

issues.issue: Was the officer's assessment of hardship upon return to Ethiopia and Austria (daughter, NDP country conditions) reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Daughter's hardship in Ethiopia and adverse country conditions were not properly assessed; the NDP was ignored; totality of evidence not applied.
issues.result_text: Officer reasonably considered conditions in Austria and the record; totality argument is a request to re-litigate.

issues.issue: Was the officer's best interests assessment of the minor applicant (bullying evidence) reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Minor will face hardship in Ethiopia; officer erred on bullying evidence and made a veiled credibility finding without a hearing.
issues.result_text: No veiled credibility finding; insufficient evidence of bullying, so best interests were reasonably assessed.

issues.issue: Is an extension of time needed to file the judicial review application?
issues.applicant_position: Applicants request an extension of time because statutory deadlines were missed.
issues.respondent_position: No extension needed; the deadline fell within the COVID-19 suspension of federal time limits.
issues.result_text: Court agrees no extension of time is needed due to the COVID-19 suspension period.
